Predicting PXR line energies

Predict ideal HOPG (002) resonance energies before simulating transport. photon_energies() takes beam energy in eV, angles in degrees, and returns a leading material axis even for one material.
At 135° observation, tilts [0.0, 30.0, 60.0]° give [984.7, 852.8, 492.3] eV. The (004) line at 30° tilt is 1705.5 eV.

Interpretation

These are vacuum line centers, not intensities or counts. The model assumes straight electrons at their entrance energy and an ideal lattice; it excludes transport, mosaic spread, in-medium dispersion and response. A kinematically allowed line need not have measurable intensity. Try changing tilt_deg, electron energy or hkl. The (004) reflection appears at twice the (002) energy for the same geometry. Compare with notebook 01's spectrum and the physics and validation documentation.
